facts.statement: The old harness offers document, file, streaming parser, and Markdown-to-HTML modes. Document mode passes the remaining input bytes and their length to cmark_parse_document.
The first eight bytes hold options and width. A zero options value selects document mode and leaves CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8 unset.
In the after scanner, the 0xFF table entry has bit 64 set, so the double-quoted attribute loop consumes that byte. A completed tag followed by a line ending can then return type 7.
The before scanner's 0xFF table entry lacks bit 64; in its double-quoted attribute state, 0xFF takes the rejection path. Thus this exact raw-byte recognition is unsupported by that scanner.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows that the rejection label returns zero when no earlier match was accepted.

facts.statement: The parser calls the type 7 block-start scanner only for an unindented line when the earlier HTML-block scan fails, the container is not a paragraph, and the line is not a lazy paragraph continuation. A successful result creates an HTML block and stores its type.

evidence.dependency_reason: Establishes the caller's guards and the effect of a successful type 7 scan.

facts.statement: A finite input can select document mode with zero options and supply a tag line containing raw 0xFF as Markdown bytes. This is an existing harness route to the changed behavior if document parsing preserves those bytes through line processing and scan_html_block_start_7 delegates to the shown scanner.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the input prefix, zero-option mode selection, and pass-through of remaining bytes to document parsing.
Shows the parser's conditional type 7 call and HTML-block creation.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe runs CMake with its defaults, builds cmark_static, and links the fuzz entry against libcmark.a.
The complete old harness contains no assertion comparing or requiring HTML-block creation; it renders and frees a non-null document and returns zero.

missing_information: The supplied text does not show cmark_parse_document and S_process_line carrying a raw 0xFF byte to the block scanner when UTF-8 validation is unset.
The supplied text does not show the scan_html_block_start_7 declaration or wrapper that connects the parser call to _scan_html_block_start_7.
